newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Yanhua IPO seen priced at HK$1.96/shr.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Yanhua IPO seen priced at HK$1.96/shr.

text.p: Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd is expected to fix the issue price of its shares at HK$1.96 each, in the middle of its indicative range from HK$1.68 to HK$2.25 each, sources close to the flotation said on Monday.
Sources said the 101.2 million shares offered to the public in Hong Kong was about 10 times subscribed.

The Chinese resins and plastics producer is due to make an official statement announcing the subscription results on Tuesday. Dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin in New York on June 24 and in Hong Kong on June 25.
Beijing Yanhua is issuing 1.012 billion new H-shares, or 30 percent of its enlarged share capital, in a global offering.
H-shares are shares of China-incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.

Of the total shares issued, 455.4 million shares will be offered to the U.S. market in the form of American Depositary Shares (ADS). Another 455.4 million shares are for international placement with the balance for public subscription in Hong Kong.
The company said both the U.S. offering and the international placement were in the form of ADS securities.
